about: Every downloadable template. The landing page's Templates section is rendered from this file; scripts/templates/generate.mjs builds the files, previews and zips it names.

items.name: Tax invoice
items.use: Bill a client. GST at 10%, bank details, 14-day terms.

items.name: Invoice and receipt workbook
items.use: The invoice and its receipt in Excel. Type the lines; GST and totals calculate themselves.

items.name: Receipt
items.use: Confirm a payment against an invoice.

items.name: Quote
items.use: Price a defined piece of work, with terms and a place to accept.

items.name: Proposal
items.use: Answer a brief: summary, approach, scope, timeline, team, investment, next steps. Dark cover.

items.name: Client deck
items.use: Thirteen 16:9 slides on four branded masters: title, agenda, section, statement, process, figures, timeline, team, case study, investment, closing.

items.name: Statement of work
items.use: Agree scope, deliverables, acceptance, fees and change control, with signatures. Dark cover.

items.name: Status report
items.use: Report progress to a client: summary, workstreams, milestones, risks, decisions needed.

items.name: Meeting agenda and notes
items.use: Run a client meeting and record decisions and actions.

items.name: Capability statement
items.use: One page on who we are and what we deliver, for tenders and introductions.

items.name: Letterhead
items.use: Any formal letter: the lockup, sender details, the legal line.

items.name: Business card
items.use: 90 by 55mm with 3mm bleed. Edit the back, export to PDF, send to the printer.

items.name: Email signature
items.use: One table that pastes into Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail. Instructions inside.

items.name: Logo pack
items.use: The mark and lockup for dark and light grounds, as SVG and PNG.
